visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a beige V-neck t-shirt, sits in front of a wall with black and white floral/bird wallpaper. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and hand gestures, introducing the topic. (2) She holds a heart-shaped pink mirror and applies a lip gloss wand to her lips. A small white dog appears on her right, watching. She then swipes the product onto her left wrist for a color comparison. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of her lips, showing a glossy finish. She points to different areas of her face and gestures broadly while speaking excitedly. (4) She leans back and laughs heartily, mouth wide open, displaying a high level of energy. The small white dog remains partially visible beside her. (5) She concludes the segment by looking directly into the lens, smiling, and performing a hand-waving farewell gesture.

(12) [Subtitle]: 怎麼判斷的?. (13) [Variety]: 粉?. (14) [Variety]: 他有亮粉. (15) [Subtitle]: 他有亮粉. (16) [Subtitle]: 我覺得國際專櫃品牌很喜歡做這些事情. (17) [Subtitle]: 喜歡放亮粉在裡面. (18) [Subtitle]: 這個就沒有啊! 這個就沒有亮粉!. visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with dark hair tied back in a low bun, wearing a plain beige short-sleeved t-shirt and minimal jewelry.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A wall with ornate floral and bird pattern wallpaper; a white sofa is partially visible behind the subject.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female greeting, spoken with rapid cadence and bright pitch. Upbeat electronic BGM with a clear drum beat (approx 120 BPM) starts simultaneously. (2) A 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The female host's speech remains densely packed, accompanied by conversational laughter from a male voice off-camera. Music continues as a steady, energetic layer underneath. (3) Sudden 'pop' and 'magic' sound effects are inserted during product application descriptions. The female voice exhibits significant pitch variability, alternating between narrative explanation and excited exclamations. (4) The track concludes with the female host's voice maintaining a high valence and positive tone. The music volume is maintained consistently until a quick fade-out at the very end as she says goodbye.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Comparison Test -> Sensory Feedback -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a beauty comparison guide, testing a high-end Dior lip gloss against an affordable Visee alternative. The creator analyzes sensory details like 'spiciness' (plumping sensation) and texture to determine if the budget version is a viable 'dupe'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed product presentation, side-by-side performance testing, and call-to-action for viewers to share other budget-friendly options.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a lively, interactive atmosphere boosted by off-camera banter and the presence of a pet dog, which enhances the creator's approachable persona. The use of 'Variety show' style text overlays is highly characteristic of modern Asian social media content.
